fieldNotes._site: Positively identified as the Constellation Brands beer DC at 600 Whittaker Road, Imeson Industrial Park, North Jacksonville FL — 469,830 SF on 24 acres, 54 docks, ~1.5 mi east of I-95, first Constellation DC in North Florida; receives beer by rail, distributes by truck. Confirmed via Jacksonville Daily Record (2022), CBRE, REBusinessOnline, and current 2025/2026 satellite + 2025-02 Street View.
fieldNotes._geocode: Roster pin (ROOFTOP, moved 204 m) landed on the correct building; locked center refined to the building centroid 30.42385, -81.63238.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — z21 satellite and 2025-02 Street View clearly show a controlled truck entrance off Whittaker Rd at the NE corner: a landscaped median island with gate arms across the lane(s) and a vehicle stopped at the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE — a small staffed guard booth sits on the entrance island beside the truck lane (clearly visible in z21 satellite and confirmed in Street View as a small white booth). Roster source explicitly notes a 'guard house.'
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE — guard shack is present, so this is a staffed gate, not a remote kiosk.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE — true cross-dock: rail-side receiving docks run along the W face (rail spur alongside), truck-side shipping docks along the E face (truck court). Two dock banks on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banded 50+. Roster cites 54 docks total; dock-door rhythm visible on both the E and W faces is consistent.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 — the E truck court holds drop trailers; a moderate number of trailer positions are visible/striped. Trailer count is modest in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE — the E-side truck court functions as a trailer drop/parking yard separate from active dock positions; roster confirms 'trailer yard.'
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE — a rail spur runs N-S directly alongside the W face of the building into the property; the W dock face is configured for rail-side unloading. Roster confirms 'direct rail access; receives beer by rail.'
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The E truck court is a long, wide concrete apron — easily holds a 3+ truck queue between the guarded gate and the dock face.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The wide E truck court inside the gate, before the dock doors, serves as an internal holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The gate apron is wide and the truck court spacious — physical room exists to add an express/bypass lane at the guarded entrance.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — the site sits inside Imeson Industrial Park, a dense built-out North Jacksonville industrial district surrounded on all sides by comparable distribution warehouses, within the Jacksonville metro.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~12 trailers visible in the captured imagery (E court and W apron); flagged uncertain as imagery dates vary and the count is approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~25 acres from the perimeter box, consistent with the roster's stated 24 acres.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One single warehouse on the parcel; neighboring warehouses are separate Imeson Industrial Park properties.
